verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say it can run recurring work on a schedule: agents can automate status updates and reports "on a set schedule", and its hosted app platform includes cron "out of the box". Both are one-line marketing claims, so how flexible and deep the scheduling is remains unproven. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule configuration (intervals, cron syntax, time zones, scheduling arbitrary workflows rather than reports), independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
